name: FLIXO manual homepage exposes the official browser-first tool experience
description: The official homepage must present the manual browser-first product, expose featured tools, and avoid any executable agent/chat entry point.

planSteps.description: Verify the official FLIXO homepage loads in Arabic and presents the browser-first manual experience.
Verify the page states that the current official path has no agent execution and that manual execution is the official path.
Verify the featured tools area includes the Background Remover, Image Upscaler, Image Cropper, Image Compressor, Image Converter, and Image Effects capabilities.
Verify there is no executable agent chat, agent workspace, or agent navigation entry point on the homepage.
